text: 硬い余弦追従ODE：SDIRK2 Stiff cosine-tracking ODE: SDIRK2 硬い余弦追従ODE：SDIRK2 y(t)=cos(t)+(y0-1)exp(-rate*t); yprime=-rate*(y-cos(t))-sin(t) rate=1000、1000/2000/4000ステップでrate*h=1,0.5,0.25。固定γ=1−1/√2と既存Newton段階解法を使用。別の減衰はy′=−10⁸y、y(0)=1、h=1。適応刻み法ではない。 Stiff cosine-tracking ODE: SDIRK2 y(t)=cos(t)+(y0-1)exp(-rate*t); yprime=-rate*(y-cos(t))-sin(t) rate=1000; 1000/2000/4000 steps give rate*h=1,0.5,0.25. Uses fixed gamma=1-1/sqrt(2) and the existing Newton stage solver. Separate decay: y'=-1e8*y, y(0)=1, h=1.
